verdict.rationale: Graphite supports some automatic rule-based triggers scoped to code review/merge workflows — AI review auto-runs on new PRs (docs-19), custom rules/comment exclusions shape reviewer behavior (docs-5, docs-20), and the merge queue automatically lands PRs based on CI status (docs-10). However these are narrow, product-specific triggers (PR opened, CI green) rather than a general-purpose rule/event/action automation framework a user could define for arbitrary events. Missing for 10: evidence of a general event-trigger/action rule engine spanning beyond review and merge (e.g., custom webhooks-to-actions, scheduling, cross-tool triggers), and independent confirmation these rules behave reliably.
